sentence: The room's themes restate in the model's terms and none of the unused concepts shows organizing the model lacks or contradicts.

The room's organizing restates in the model's terms—calls and building (P01/P03), repair and defence (P05), chat coordination (P23), neighbour help and borders (P08/P16), post-close ties (P13), arrivals through the mark (P25), and the sub's politics beside the work (K04)—and the unused concepts show no organizing the model lacks or contradicts.
